```{r}

kiaHyundaiThefts <- read.csv("kiaHyundaiThefts.csv")

# print the shape
kiaHyundaiThefts %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("count"), mean),
            percentKiaHyundai = mean(percentKiaHyundai)) %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.abb)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = percentKiaHyundai)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Average Percent of Kia/Hyundai Thefts by Month",
       x = "Month", y = "Average % Kia/Hyundai Thefts") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("tidy_data.csv")
# --- Clean and prepare data ---

df <- df %>%
  # Convert Date to Date type and extract Year and Month
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  )

# --- Summarize total "All" by Year-Month ---
df_summary <- df %>%
  # 2019 is incomplete, so we'll exclude it
  filter(Year != 2019) %>%
  # Aggregate totals
  group_by(Year, Month) %>%
  summarize(TotalAll = sum(All, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- Plot area chart ---
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = Month, y = TotalAll, fill = factor(Year), group = Year)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") + # Stacked area
  geom_line(aes(color = factor(Year)), linewidth = 1) + 
  # Customize labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "Total 'All' Counts Over Time by Year",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total All",
    fill = "Year",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # Customize theme
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```


```{r}
# --- Clean and prepare data ---
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    Year = lubridate::year(Date)
  )

# --- Aggregate totals by Location (optional if multiple dates) ---
df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarize(
    TotalAll = sum(All, na.rm = TRUE),
    AvgPercent = mean(Percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# --- Treemap ---
ggplot(df_summary, aes(
  area = TotalAll,
  fill = AvgPercent,
  label = Location
)) +
  geom_treemap(color = "white") +
  geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "black",
    place = "centre",
    grow = TRUE,
    reflow = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title = "Vehicle Counts by Location (Treemap)",
    fill = "Avg Percent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("carTheftsMap.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert "-" to NA and columns to numeric
year_cols <- c("countCarThefts2019", "countCarThefts2020", "countCarThefts2021", "countCarThefts2022")
df[year_cols] <- lapply(df[year_cols], function(x) as.numeric(gsub("-", NA, x)))

# Gather into long format
df_long <- df %>%
  select(geo_name, all_of(year_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-geo_name, names_to = "Year", values_to = "Thefts") %>%
  mutate(Year = gsub("countCarThefts", "", Year))

# Example: Top 5 cities by 2022 thefts
top_cities <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(countCarThefts2022)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(geo_name)

ggplot(df_long %>% filter(geo_name %in% top_cities), aes(x = Year, y = Thefts, color = geo_name, group = geo_name)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Car Thefts Trend (Top 5 Cities)", x = "Year", y = "Number of Thefts", color = "City") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

# Read the data
df <- read_csv("KiaHyundaiMilwaukeeData.csv")

# Create a date column for proper ordering
df <- df %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%b-%d"))

# Reshape to long format for stacking
df_long <- df %>%
  select(date, countKiaHyundaiThefts, countOtherThefts) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(countKiaHyundaiThefts, countOtherThefts),
               names_to = "Type", values_to = "Count")

# Plot stacked area chart
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = date, y = Count, fill = Type)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Stacked Area Chart of Vehicle Thefts in Milwaukee",
       x = "Date", y = "Number of Thefts", fill = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```
